title: NOTARIADO_FALSE_ROWS_PHYSICAL_EVIDENCE

same_source_variant_check.interpretation: Each of the 7 articles appears only once in the same source. No parallel variants detected (no same article with different vigencia states).
same_source_variant_check.adjudication_implication: Single false row per article does NOT establish derogation, substitution, or amendment within the same source.

cross_source_observation.title: CA01_CROSS_SOURCE_EXTENDED_OBSERVATION
cross_source_observation.note: Separate from formal CA01.5 cross-source query. Captured from extended evidence gathering.

reglamento_pcsj_17_2012.critical_distinction: Article 11 of Reglamento is a separate legal provision from Article 11 of Código del Notariado. Same num_articulo does NOT establish legal identity, amendment, replacement, or derogation.

critical_distinctions.verificado_attribute: verificado=false is a VERIFICATION ATTRIBUTE (content validation status), NOT a legal status indicator. Must remain logically separate from es_norma_vigente.
critical_distinctions.same_source_variant: Each of the 7 articles appears only once (no parallel variants). Absence of parallel variant does NOT establish derogation.
critical_distinctions.cross_source_numeric_match: Same num_articulo across different legal instruments does NOT establish legal identity, amendment, replacement, or derogation. Article 11 of Reglamento ≠ Article 11 of Código.
critical_distinctions.absence_of_metadata: Absence of legal-status metadata fields (decreto, reforma, reformado_por, derogado_por, etc.) in the false rows does NOT establish legal status. Absence is simply absence; no inference applies.
